title: Conditions Without Si: De + Infinitive and the Gerund
goal: Say a condition without si, with de and an infinitive or with a gerund.

items: I can say a condition without si with de and an infinitive, in the present and the past.
I can say a condition with a gerund when the subject is the same.
I can use the new words for causes and foresight.
